title: Precarity and Wellbeing Among Freelance Platform Workers: A Qualitative Study
abstract: A qualitative interview study exploring how income precarity shapes subjective wellbeing among freelance workers on digital labour platforms.

title: Algorithmic Management and Gig Worker Mental Health: A Systematic Review
abstract: A systematic review of studies examining the relationship between algorithmic management practices and gig workers' mental health outcomes.

title: Platform Work and Burnout: A Survey of Ride-Hailing Drivers
abstract: A cross-sectional survey of ride-hailing drivers examining burnout prevalence and its association with shift length and platform rating pressure.
